traits.name: Retributive Suplex
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A Medium or smaller creature attempts a melee Strike against the eunemvro and the attack roll is a critical failure Effect The eunemvro seizes the triggering creature, using the attacker's momentum to send them flailing overhead. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 23 Reflex save or be forcibly moved to a space on the opposite side of the eunemvro, landing prone.

traits.name: Blessed Strikes
traits.text: The eunemvro's Strikes deal damage that's either bludgeoning or positive—whichever deals more damage to the target creature.

traits.name: Tide of Creation
traits.text: ⬺ (evocation, light, occult, positive); Requirements The eunemvro isn't fatigued Effect The eunemvro channels from their soul a blast of searing positive energy, bathing their enemies in a wave of blinding light and cosmic power. The eunemvro creates either a 10-foot cone or a 30-foot line, dealing 6d8 (6d8) positive damage (DC 22 basic Fortitude save). A creature that critically fails its save is blinded for 1d4 (1d4) rounds. After using this ability, the eunemvro becomes fatigued.

actions.text: ⬻ fist +14 (agile, magical); Damage 2d6+6 (2d6+6) bludgeoning or positive
